newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BOURSE REOPENING EXTENDED TO THREE HOURS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BOURSE REOPENING EXTENDED TO THREE HOURS.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange said on Monday that it was extending the morning reopening trade session to three hours from one starting today.
"The morning price fix will now last from 1100 till 1400 (0800-1000 GMT) with the central market open for both selling and buying transactions," the bourse's spokeswoman told Reuters.
The official statistics for the day's trading would be made available around 1600, she added.
